help.body:
📖 *Freedom Bot Help*

① `/start` — Dashboard
② `/users` — Manage users, UUIDs and inbound assignments
③ `/nodes` — Manage REALITY and XHTTP inbounds
④ `/traffic` — User traffic; `/inboundtraffic` — Inbound traffic
⑤ `/online` — Online clients and observed source IPs
⑥ `/stats` — Statistics collection switches and repair
⑦ `/version` — Local and upstream versions
⑧ `/update` — Update manager and Bot; core updates require confirmation
⑨ `/restart` — Restart Xray after confirmation
⑩ `/language en|zh-CN` — Select interface language

Commands: `/adduser phone`, `/disableuser phone`, `/enableuser phone`.

🔒 Management is limited to authorized private chats. Changes and core updates require explicit permissions.

stats.title:
📊 Statistics switches

Xray controls these switches; when one is off, the related feature cannot collect data:
stats.xff: ℹ️ XHTTP inbounds without trustedXForwardedFor: %s (needed only behind a CDN; ignore for direct connections)
stats.api.hint: ⚠️ The Stats API scaffold is incomplete. The repair action can add a loopback-only listener and its API route after confirmation.
stats.repairhint: Enabling or repairing validates the config first, then restarts Xray once (active sessions may reconnect briefly); failures roll back automatically.
stats.repairconfirm:
Repair statistics?

This enables user and inbound counters and adds a loopback-only Stats API listener and route if needed. Existing incompatible listeners are rejected.

The configuration is validated before one Xray restart; active sessions may reconnect briefly, and failures roll back automatically.
stats.inbound.off: ⚠️ Inbound statistics are off, so node traffic will stay empty. Open Stats switches to enable them.
stats.traffic.off: ⚠️ Per-user traffic statistics are off for level(s) %s, so usage and quota stay at 0. Open Stats switches to enable them.
node.listenaddressprompt: Enter the listener IP address, or - to listen on all interfaces. Changing this can disconnect clients.
node.listenaddressinvalid: Enter a valid IPv4/IPv6 address, or - for all interfaces.
routing.edit.ruleprompt: Send one JSON field rule with a unique ruleTag, a condition, and an existing outboundTag or balancerTag. Example: {"ruleTag":"ads","domain":["geosite:category-ads-all"],"outboundTag":"block"}. New rules are appended. /cancel cancels.
routing.edit.deleteprompt: Send the ruleTag of the named rule to delete. /cancel cancels.
routing.edit.confirm: Confirm routing change: %s (%s). Xray will validate the config and restart.
service.ask.stop: Stop Xray? All active connections will be disconnected. Traffic is sampled first when possible.
network.outbound.prompt: Send a native Xray outbound JSON object with tag and protocol. Existing tags are replaced; new tags are appended. Example: {"tag":"block2","protocol":"blackhole"}. Telegram Bot chats are not end-to-end encrypted: use the local agent CLI for credentials. /cancel cancels.
network.outbound.deleteprompt: Send the outbound tag to delete. The default, API, referenced outbounds and outbounds with balancers are protected. /cancel cancels.
network.dns.prompt: Send the complete native Xray DNS JSON object, for example {"servers":["1.1.1.1"]}. This replaces the existing DNS object. Telegram Bot chats are not end-to-end encrypted: use the local agent CLI for secrets. /cancel cancels.
serverhost.prompt: Send the public hostname or IP used by REALITY client links, or - to use automatic discovery. /cancel cancels.
serverhost.confirm: Use %s as the public link address? This takes effect on the next export without restarting Xray.
service.ask.collector: Install or refresh the independent statistics collector? This changes its systemd service and may restart Xray to enable statistics.
service.done.collector: Statistics collector installed and started. Check Online diagnostics for policy and API status.
